baseline_models.focus_anchor: The king orders that Joseph be brought, but when the messenger arrives Joseph commands him to return.
baseline_models.mechanism: A one-way sovereign summons becomes a reversible speech circuit. The person treated as the object of transfer takes control of the relay and sends royal initiative back toward its source before allowing bodily movement toward court.

activation_trace.role: Royal sovereignty supplies the initiating command and the jurisdiction whose process is being redirected.
Requested arrival supplies the linear movement toward the king that Joseph interrupts.
The carrier-of-speech sense makes the envoy a relay that can bear a countermessage rather than merely retrieve a body.
Returned answer and speech turn the imperative into a procedural reply sent back to the command's source.

changed_reading.before: Joseph delays compliance with a royal summons until a question is answered.
changed_reading.after: Joseph converts retrieval into an appellate loop: royal speech cannot move his body until his counter-speech has moved back through the same channel.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ask him what was the affair of the women who cut their hands; my Lord knows their scheme.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question joins an inward or situational affair to visible wounds and then to knowledge. The cuts are material marks, but not self-interpreting proof; inquiry must separate the matter, agency, and scheme that produced them.

activation_trace.role: Direct asking supplies the formal act by which the concealed affair is made answerable.
The inward concern or state of mind widens the requested object beyond the bare fact of injury.
The branch's separation of a matter or right makes the physical cutting also cue adjudicative differentiation.
The injured bodily hands provide the public, inspectable traces around which testimony can be organized.
The discriminating-mark sense turns the wounds into signs that point toward, without by themselves proving, the hidden scheme.

changed_reading.before: Joseph asks the king to recall a notorious incident.
changed_reading.after: Joseph demands a forensic reconstruction in which bodily traces trigger testimony and judgment rather than substitute for them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The messenger is sent back to your lord, while Joseph closes by saying that my Lord knows.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated lord-word links two levels of authority but assigns them different operations. The messenger's lord can convene and ask within the polity; Joseph's Lord already knows the concealed scheme, placing human inquiry under a wider epistemic horizon.

activation_trace.role: The shared lordship and mastery branch binds the two possessive forms while preserving their distinct referents.
Human kingship supplies the finite authority able to order attendance and conduct an inquiry.
Questioning marks the human ruler's need to acquire what is not yet institutionally established.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the contrasting divine cognition of the scheme.

changed_reading.before: My Lord knows is a devotional assurance appended to a request addressed to the king.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages two nonidentical jurisdictions: human mastery must investigate and establish publicly what divine mastery already encompasses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The women cut their own hands, and the verse immediately frames the incident through their scheme.
baseline_models.mechanism: Literal injured hands coexist with hand as capacity and deed. On this focus-only reading, intense scheming rebounds into the agents' own instruments of action, making disrupted agency itself part of the evidence.

activation_trace.role: Repeated bodily cutting keeps the model anchored in the stated physical injury.
Hand as capacity lets the wounded organ also register a temporary failure of controlled agency.
Attribution of deeds to hands makes the self-directed injury an embodied record of what the participants did.
Strenuous manipulation supplies the force whose effects appear to recoil upon the manipulators' own capacities.

changed_reading.before: The cut hands are a memorable spectacle associated with the women's plot.
changed_reading.after: The wounds can also be carried as a compact image of agency rebounding: manipulation becomes legible where the manipulators lose command of their own hands.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, incoming provision is temporally subordinated to delivered interpretation, and that information is attributed to Lord-taught knowledge. The focus reuses the ordering principle: truthful account must travel before Joseph does.

activation_trace.role: A report that arrives and is conveyed establishes information delivery as Joseph's active function in prison.
Disclosed knowledge supplies the epistemic resource explicitly placed before the next arrival.
Lord-linked learning grounds the priority of truthful interpretation rather than personal status.
The returned message operationalizes the same information-before-movement ordering at the royal threshold.

structural_cues: In 12:37 Joseph places interpretation before the next arrival of food; in 12:50 he places investigation before his own requested arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated temporal precedence of information over arrival; I infer an epistemic policy, while a live alternative is that the focus simply records a tactical delay.

changed_reading.before: The return command is a condition added to release.
changed_reading.after: The return command extends Joseph's established ordering of events: disclosure and verification must arrive before the person or benefit whose arrival is pending.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prison discourse distinguishes scattered lordships from one divine authority and distinguishes coercive proof from judgment. This sharpens the focus's two lord-forms into a deliberate allocation of tasks rather than a loose honorific echo.

activation_trace.role: Differentiating between things activates close attention to the two lord-references in the focus.
Compelling warrant supplies the missing public basis that the requested inquiry must establish.
Judgment between people supplies the adjudicative frame within which the king's questioning operates.
The repeated mastery term carries the now-sharpened relation between finite ruler and divine knower.

structural_cues: The contrast of plural separated lords with the one God in 12:39-40 precedes the focus's your lord/my Lord pairing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit authority contrasts; I assign the king public fact-finding and God encompassing knowledge, while the alternative is ordinary alternation between master and God without a procedural claim.

changed_reading.before: Your lord and my Lord merely refer to two different authorities.
changed_reading.after: Their juxtaposition allocates jurisdiction: the king must produce a warranted human judgment, while divine knowledge limits and oversees that process.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier request to mention Joseph before the ruler is lost through forgetting, prolonging confinement; recollection later reopens the relay. Returning the new messenger with a concrete public question therefore functions as protection against another private, memory-dependent appeal.

activation_trace.role: Loss of remembrance supplies the demonstrated failure mode of an informal message to power.
Continued dwelling in prison supplies the material cost of that failed relay.
Recovered remembrance shows how contingent the first route to royal attention was.
The renewed carrier-of-speech route supplies the precursor to the messenger who reaches Joseph in the focus.
A specified question converts a fragile plea for remembrance into an answerable public task.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from mention-me-before-your-lord, through forgetting and prolonged prison, to remembered sending and finally a messenger who is explicitly sent back.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one failed and one restored relay; I infer that Joseph designs the focus request to externalize the claim, while the alternative is that the recurrence only explains how the messenger became available.

changed_reading.before: Joseph rejects dependence on royal favor.
changed_reading.after: Joseph replaces a previously failed favor-and-memory channel with a durable procedure whose question must be heard, investigated, and answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The requested inquiry is enacted as review of the women's affair. Its open collective question yields differentiated responses: a group disclaims known wrong, then one participant names her own solicitation, after which truth is said to emerge and Joseph's truthfulness is affirmed.

activation_trace.role: Review through speech realizes the focus request as an inquiry rather than a summary accusation.
Solicitation supplies the specific action that emerges from the broader question about the women's affair.
Truth becoming uncovered supplies the transition from latent scheme to public account.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the institutional result of the returned question.
Truthful speech supplies the final testimonial assessment produced by the inquiry.
Separation of a matter or right anticipates the inquiry's differentiation of collective and individual testimony.

structural_cues: The focus asks what was the affair of the women without asserting a complete answer; 12:51 preserves that openness long enough for a first-person admission to emerge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an open question followed by differentiated testimony; I infer that the grammar is procedurally productive, while a live alternative is that the king already knew the target and staged confirmation.

changed_reading.before: Joseph asks the king to establish his innocence.
changed_reading.after: Joseph asks for a process whose open form allows witnesses to separate themselves and finally lets the principal actor formulate the decisive admission in her own voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's their scheme is followed by concern with betrayal in absence, the failed guidance of betrayers' scheming, and an explicit refusal of total self-exoneration. The sequence preserves the scheme as real evidence while resisting its expansion into a complete moral diagnosis of everyone else.

activation_trace.role: Deficient fidelity narrows the issue from a gendered category to the ethically specific act of betrayal.
Hiddenness from sight makes conduct in another's absence the test applied after public inquiry.
Scheming recurs with betrayers rather than women as its governing class, reopening the scope of the focus attribution.
Refusal of complete separation from fault checks a triumphalist use of the preceding vindication.
The inward faculty of thought and impulse relocates moral risk inside the self as well as in an external scheme.
The focus's concrete deceit claim remains the anchor being bounded, not erased.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from their scheme in 12:50 to betrayers' scheme in 12:52 and then to non-exoneration of the self in 12:53.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies this sequence; I infer a deliberate narrowing and rebroadening of moral agency, while uncertainty about voice continuity in 12:52-53 leaves a live alternative that the final maxim does not qualify Joseph's own request.

changed_reading.before: Joseph identifies the women as schemers and seeks uncomplicated personal exoneration.
changed_reading.after: Joseph names a real scheme for investigation, but the following sequence recasts deceit as betrayal under hidden conditions and places even the vindicated self under moral scrutiny.

context_deltas.mechanism: The king's bring-him command is repeated almost verbatim after the inquiry. This time direct speech is followed by a declaration of standing, capability, and trust, so the focus's interruption changes the institutional quality of arrival.

activation_trace.role: The same royal sovereignty reissues the summons after the evidentiary interval.
Repeated requested arrival makes the before-and-after comparison explicit.
Mutually intelligible speech replaces the earlier indirect relay once the inquiry has cleared the threshold.
Empowerment supplies the changed institutional position attached to the second arrival.
Settled trust supplies the relational status absent from the first retrieval order.
The commanded return is the intervening reversal that separates the two otherwise similar summonses.

structural_cues: 12:54 repeats the focus opening, then adds direct conversation and the paired status terms established and trusted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition plus changed aftermath; I infer that the inquiry transforms the terms of access, while direct royal evaluation after conversation remains a material alternative cause of the new status.

changed_reading.before: Joseph's refusal postpones an unchanged offer of release.
changed_reading.after: The refusal is a transformation gate: the first summons seeks an object to be brought, whereas the second receives a publicly cleared interlocutor into trusted standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: After divine knowledge of a hidden scheme frames the focus, Joseph later joins his own knowledge to guarding storehouses. Epistemic discrimination moves from defensive truth-recovery into the positive custody of vulnerable resources.

activation_trace.role: Securing and storing resources supplies the new administrative domain for tested judgment.
Active guardianship turns reliable knowledge into a practice of custody.
Knowledge recurs as Joseph's stated qualification, extending the focus's epistemic vocabulary into governance.
Divine disclosure of concealed scheming supplies the prior model of knowledge against which human knowing is measured.

structural_cues: The focus ends with my Lord knowing; 12:55 ends with Joseph describing himself as guarding and knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition and the move into storehouse custody; I infer one ethic of accountable discrimination, while the alternative is that knowing in 12:55 denotes only technical competence.

changed_reading.before: The focus invokes knowledge solely to defend Joseph against a hidden plot.
changed_reading.after: The inquiry tests a kind of truth-sensitive agency that can later be entrusted with preservation: knowledge becomes not only vindication but qualification for custody.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation links repeated pressing-until-fluid-emerges to the secondary extraction branch under the focus question. It remains anchored in ask, return, and the cut-hand evidence, but downstream prose should present it as a process analogy for eliciting latent testimony, not as the lexical meaning of asking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Return to your lord and ask him about the cut-hand incident.

activation_trace.role: Pressing until liquid is expressed supplies the first material image of latent content made to emerge.
The repeated pressing image after relief makes extraction a framing recurrence rather than a single local accident.
The form-distant drawing-out branch lets questioning function as careful extraction of what is lodged inside the affair.
Separation of a matter gives the extracted testimony an adjudicative destination.

changed_reading.before: Joseph requests a neutral question about a past event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he routes controlled institutional pressure back into the affair so that concealed testimony can be drawn out and separated into a judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a material analogy across agriculture and legal procedure, surprising because grain storage is not the overt subject of 12:50. It stays anchored in the focus's return, inquiry, cutting, and discriminating knowledge; downstream prose should say the claim behaves like something deliberately preserved, not identify innocence with grain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Joseph leaves the summons unconsumed, sends it back, and requires the cut-hand evidence to be opened through inquiry.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful cutting at harvest supplies a controlled counterpart to the uncontrolled bodily cutting named in the focus.
Deliberately leaving something in place supplies the pause that protects value from immediate consumption.
Preservation inside a protective enclosure supplies the storage logic applied analogically to Joseph's unresolved claim.
Sending the summons back is the focus action that withholds immediate release until the claim can be safely processed.
Discriminating marks keep the preserved claim tied to inspectable evidence rather than private insistence.

changed_reading.before: Joseph stalls release until his reputation is addressed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he stores rather than spends the summons, preserving the value of public vindication until an inquiry can open and distribute its evidence.

strongest_changes: The messenger's return becomes an anti-forgetting public procedure after the earlier private relay failed.
The open question in 12:50 generates self-differentiating testimony and a first-person admission in 12:51.
The nearly repeated summons in 12:54 shows that the interruption changes arrival from retrieval into trusted standing.
Their scheme remains a real claim but is bounded by the subsequent language of betrayal, hiddenness, and non-exoneration of the self.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a hinge made of reversals and recurrences: speech returns before the body moves, bodily cuts become evidentiary marks, two lordships divide knowing from public judgment, and the repeated royal command reveals that inquiry has changed the social meaning of the same requested arrival.
remaining_uncertainties: The jurisdictional force of your lord/my Lord may exceed what is intended by ordinary reference to master and God.
The bounding effect of 12:52-53 depends partly on unresolved voice continuity.
Pressure-extraction and evidentiary-storage are branch-anchored process analogies, but they remain cross-domain and should not displace the stronger procedural readings.
